authority: Paleta y tipografías originales de Muni.

fontFallbackPolicy.headingMissingGlyph: Use MilkyNiceClean for the entire heading when MatchaMint lacks any required character. Keep the original text unchanged.
fontFallbackPolicy.bodyMissingGlyph: Use a verified system font for the entire word if MilkyNiceClean lacks a character. Never remove accents or replace linguistic apostrophes to fit a font.
fontFallbackPolicy.reason: The supplied Matcha Mint file lacks Spanish accented vowels, ñ, ü and inverted question/exclamation marks.
